payout_quote: This offer is limited to a new Associated Bank business checking account opened and funded through October 2, 2026. Open a new Associated business checking account with a minimum opening deposit of $100 and receive up to a $750 Bonus with one of three options: A. Open a Business Access Checking account and receive a $100 bonus with a minimum deposit of $2,000 in new money within 30 days of account opening. Also, must maintain a minimum daily balance of $2,000 between days 31 to 90 after opening your account. OR B. ... $400 bonus ... $5,000 ... OR C. ... $750 bonus ... $20,000... The bonus is deposited into the new Associated Bank business checking account within 120 days of account opening. Account must be open at the time the bonus is paid and must remain open for a minimum of 12 months. If the account is closed within 12 months, Associated Bank reserves the right to deduct the monetary bonus from the account prior to closing. (Official Associated Bank offer page, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Bonus deposited within 120 days of account opening; account must remain open 12 months or bonus is clawed back
eligibility: Business owners; new Associated Bank business checking account; opened and funded through October 2, 2026; new money must come from outside Associated Bank
steps: Choose your tier: Business Access ($100 / $2,000), Business Balanced ($400 / $5,000), or Business Choice ($750 / $20,000)
Open the new business checking account with $100+ before October 2, 2026
Deposit the required new money (from outside Associated Bank) within 30 days
Maintain the minimum daily balance every day from day 31 to day 90
Keep the account open 12 months; bonus posts within 120 days of opening
catches: BUSINESS ACCOUNT REQUIRED - you need a real business to open this; not for personal banking
TIME-BOUND: must open and fund by October 2, 2026 (9 days from verification)
12-MONTH CLAWBACK: close the account within a year and they deduct the bonus back
Slow payout: bonus posts within 120 days of opening
You must park $2,000-$20,000 for 90 days - the money is tied up
New money only - transfers from existing Associated Bank accounts don't count
biggest_catch: This requires a real business and parking $2,000+ for 90 days - plus the bonus is clawed back if you close the account within 12 months. Only makes sense if you actually need a business checking account.

maximize: Only do this if you genuinely need a business checking account - don't form a business just for $100. The Business Access tier ($100 for $2,000 parked 90 days) is the sensible play; the higher tiers tie up serious cash for marginal extra bonus. Fund with new money on day one and set a calendar reminder for day 90 to confirm the balance never dipped. Keep the account open the full 12 months - the clawback makes early closure a guaranteed loss.
